footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Chatham Lodging Trust: after $8.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 7.0% to $295M in 2025. Operating income rose 23.0% to $40.9M, a 13.9% margin.

Net income was $7.1M, or $0.14 per share, after a $3.8M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $64.1M and free cash flow $64.1M, versus $43.2M; Chatham Lodging Trust returned $26.6M through dividends and buybacks.
